quotes.text:
> Terrible, having local company's instead of internet controlling behemoths who made it the opposite of a distributed information exchange network (you know the core idea of arpanet).

Please ask any local company to build such infra. Unfortunately, they dont. Or once they become big - founders sell to SV.

> s Germany's problems and not those of Norway.

Do you mean all Norwegian newspapers https://www.aftenposten.no/ (local company) do not track? See ublock origin. Look at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=no.cita playstore app - see number of trackers.

This is a human problem. As long as developers are ready to code this will happen.
quotes.story_title: Norway takes a stance against Google Analytics
